Body: I read a previous review stating that the returns process is unnecessarily difficult and I couldn't agree more. The company also shockingly have no idea on UK legislation when it's comes to consumer rights. I bought a cordless lamp, bamboo with seagrass lamp shade and when first received it was great, went to recharge and it just got dimmer and summer and eventually stopped working altogether. I purchased 1x in the hope it would be a great product and then I'd buy a further 8 or 9 for our garden wedding in May. I got in touch and requested a returns label/qr code so I could send the lamp back as I'm within the original 6 months of purchase and the item is faulty. I've decided I no longer want to go down this route for lighting at the wedding as I've lost faith in the product and it's longevity so I want to return for a refund...they keep asking for videos and photos and I keep saying, but I could have just switched it off!! That won't prove anything. They also don't understand that it's repair, replace or refund and that the choice is the consumers and not their and they also seem unaware that they have 14 days to resolve from when I broached them about the issue. Lisa is off to ask Sarah if it's ok which regardless of what Sarah says ....it is, it's the law, anyway it's been two days since my last response from them so here's hoping they're off on a training course together.
Heading: Beautiful product but shoddy staff...never again!!

Author: Jane Shelswell
Body:
Nothing new... I ordered November 2024 x2green parrot candle holders but they weren't  available in the UK even though i had an alert to say available. I only realised after paying , this order had to be shipped from USA...
Easy, one would think, think again !
I have chased this up rather than regular updates. The shipping dates changed x3! Jan, March 15th, now April 2nd.The latest response from customer service is they were sorry I hadn't read their update that they sent me on March 17th (!) They said it appears unread & maybe gone into my spam folder. Difficult to read something that I never received and i check ALL folders every day. A little like my order, not received!
1/I suggest you sent it to someone else or 
2/dare I say you aren't being truthful but merely making out you updated me. You haven't spontaneously updated me before, youve only replied to my queries. So, why would I think you've done so spontaneously on March 17th? 


The website has now miraculously changed the dispatch date to April 2nd...since my November order, don't you think that's a shocking service. In fact please DON'T respond as it's as usual, just very PC/HR neutral terminology in an attempt to neutralise my feedback. A simple feedback to my incessant emails with 'item not available and we've refunded you' instead of giving false hope of a delivery time.
I'm sure some have had positive experiences, my one previous order arrived ok but item was already in the uk. I'm sorry but I couldn't recommend you aftercall of this because selling items not available shouldn't occur. 4+months wait is truly unacceptable , so I cancelled my order& hope the refund happens within the week. Shame 😢

update :Thankyou for the prompt refund. A good response. 
BUT... 
As I thought, you've replied with HR speak to dilute the truthful customer experience. You sent a copy of the March email as requested and i realise why it was deleted, it was some green bordered, almost promotional looking email so i mistook it for an advert rather than a plain email to acknowledge further delay which probably continues. So I apologise for accusing you of not sending it but all previous emails were sent to me as a response to my enquiries as per email chain. 

ALL previous emails were a response to MY enquiries asking where the product had got to. It's a bit embarrassing having to keep telling a customer of extended shipping times tbh, you must know why it's delayed ie clearly not available.

I also added in those emails that my feedback would not be good as I'm sure you'd understand. You sent customer satisfaction requests a couple of times but I realised these are internal not public hence I posted on here instead. Again I'm grateful you refunded so quickly but perhaps it's just easier all round to not sell an item that is NOT readily available in the first place, simple!
I'm sure others might have better experiences but for an established company this was not a good experience so I unsubscribed and wouldn't entertain the risk. As I said, it's a shame.

Author: Tracy Thurman
Body:
I was looking for something a bit special, when I came across, what appeared to be some good quality small rattan effect reindeer from Mrs Alice, l paid around £100 for the pair.   l expected they would be good quality and would last for many years of festive display, they arrived in lovely packaging and l was delighted, however this was short lived as sadly they turned out to be faulty, poor quality for the price paid and not fit for purpose. 

When l purchased the first pair of reindeer part of the leg fell off the first one, and not long after on the second one too,  literally for no reason! strangely in very similar locations on the leg, l couldn't understand it as they only been in place about a week and hadn't been touched (were just stood on the floor in my sitting room as part of my Christmas décor) this was very odd as room only lightly used and only by 2 adults?  I was upset and couldn't understand it, so my partner replaced them for me and bought me another set ready for this Christmas 2024. I realise now I should have asked for a refund at this time, but gave them the benefit of the doubt and just repurchased.

Fast foward to this Christmas when l got the new unused set out a few weeks ago, and guess what?!...In the last week l have discovered the legs have again fallen off both of the deer in the new 
unused set too, again within a few weeks of them being placed on display!!  

Sadly l now know this definitely down to a fault/quality issue, the material used is porous/brittle and causes the legs to fall 
apart after just getting them out of the box and placing them on the floor. 
As it has now become obvious that this is a design/manufacturing flaw I have contacted Mrs Alice but they aren't prepared to do anything, due to the purchase timescale involved, obviously I'm aware of this, but considering the new set were only got out a few weeks ago, I would have thought the fact that there is clearly an issue within the product they may have made exception, but no.. Therefore l have now spent around £200 on small decorative deer that all lost their legs because of poor quality/design fault within a few weeks of being put on display, which is completely unacceptable.

Hugely disappointing experience with Mrs Alice. 

***Update..thank you for your reply to my review Mrs Alice, it certainly is frustrating as the first pair of reindeer were simply drlivered by you, and got out of the box straight away, they were then carefully placed on display, the legs just came apart after a few weeks of this, the second replacement pair were not removed from the box, l stored them in the box you sent them in in the corner of the attic until getting them out this Christmas, where once again l simply got them out the box and put them on 
display and within a few weeks the legs had once again fallen off. 

Both sets were untouched and the replacement set stored correctly in your packaging untouched and yet both sets lasted a few weeks only before legs fell off!! so there was actually no time for any
 wear and tear!! In the circumstances it is absolutely obvious and so very clearly a design fault on these, unless its acceptable for a set of decorative reindeer costing around £100 to last around 2 weeks after being placed on display, before their legs fall off and they have to be thrown away... not just on one new set but two new sets!!? and whilst l appreciate your policy on reporting faults etc, in this case it's pretty obvious there's an issue with the product itself, so l feel an exception could have been made in the interests of fairness and good customer service.
Heading: Look beautiful but poor quality…

Author: Sarah
Body:
Updated review: I initially gave 2 stars but following my review I received helpful customer support. I chose to keep the dressing gown and it's fine to wear - seems to have softened, although I suspect the white trim will turn pink in the wash. I do feel that the materials ought to be listed on the clothing item. Anyway, I felt it only fair to add a star and to say I would order from Mrs Alice again. Probably. 


This is my first experience with Mrs Alice. I like the look of the products and find the Instagram stories etc. entertaining and inspiring. I decided to place an order in the sale and purchased the tartan dressing gown and fake snow. After 8 days I'd heard nothing other than a confirmation email so I had to get in touch with customer services to find out what was happening. This was disappointing and such a waste of time. You pay £5 for delivery so it should be there much faster and if there's a delay the customer needs to be notified. On the positive side, the customer service advisor apologised and arranged for my order to be expedited and it arrived 2 days later. 
The parcel was nicely packaged in an attractive box which was lovely to receive. The fake snow boxes were much more substantial than I'd expected and will be a cute stocking filler (I like to put things aside throughout the year). But the dressing gown...what a disappointment. It feels SO cheap and plasticy, almost like it's coated in something. I was expecting brushed cotton at that price point but what I have is a very thin nylony thing. There's no info about its fabric composition on the garment, but the whole thing feels really cheap and lacks substance. I know it'll be too much of a faff and expense to return it (having already paid the £5 for the slow delivery in the first place) so I probably won't bother, but I'm truly disappointed. This was supposed to be a treat for me and I honestly cannot imagine wearing it and unfortunately it makes me question the quality of the other items. I try to shop small and buy from independent businesses as much as possible, but this wasn't good enough and the quality needs to be higher. 
So overall, a very underwhelming experience. A shame.
Heading: Material Girl

Author: Geralyne Di
Body:
Andréanne at Madame Alice is not a good person.        I stayed at her house through Workaway to help out on Mother's Day weekend.  
She is unkind, she never said "good morning" or "how did you sleep?" In fact, I did not sleep well as the bed was like cardboard with lumps. So worked hard for 3 days, 8 hours each day, but could not sleep. What could I do?  I decided to leave. 
At the end of my last day working at the florist, her boyfriend drove me back to her house on Isle d'Orleans. I looked into my purse to get my cellphone and noticed a strange thing in there: a hook with strings hanging from it. I pulled it out and asked aloud: What is this? How did it get in my purse? 
Her boyfriend who was driving, glanced over and recognized it: "it is something of Andréanne's." I asked: "How did it get into my purse?" I told him that I would leave it on the car seat for her. 
 The next morning, she rushed over to the car as I was loading my bags to catch my lift back to Ottawa. "I need to check your bags!" Why?  I asked. I wouldn't want anything of yours!" She looked very anxious and said that I stole her earring. 
I then realized that the strange object I found in my bag was her earring. I told her that Ieft it on the carseat in Louis' car. 
A while later it clicked: Out of spite, she had planted that earring in my purse and wanted to search and find it there so she could accuse me of stealing. 
She should be thankful for my work over the 3 busy days + the cooking in the evening which I did for the other workaway girl, Marin.
​Be aware!  She is not a good person.
Heading: Andréanne at Madame Alice not a good…

Author: Carina
Body: When I ordered a pair of bird-candle holders, I expected fine craftsmanship for such a rather pricey item. In your ad, they looked so very elegant and absolutely beautiful. Delivery was easy and prompt, the 2 smaller cases inside the shipping box came neatly packed in blue tissue paper, with a pretty light-blue bow. Upon opening on my birthday: huge, HUGE disappointment. Brittle styrofoam containers, making a mess in my living room, revealed 2 crudely mass-produced made-in-China bird-candleholders that did in no way match the lovely pictures in the advertising which had prompted me to spend the money on these 2 expensive items. The little eyes of these poor birds were crudely slashed over with the blue paint that was meant for the feathers. The body of those resin birds lacked detail by just having been plainly painted with 2 tone blue (I had actually requested in my online order form that the blue color of the birds be a bit darker tinged, like some of those in your pictures were). But it seems that someone just grabbed 2 taped-close styrofoam containers out of the shipment from the PRC and simply re-wrapped them. I had to purchase white paint for the eyes, black and yellow for the pupils, to carefully give these ugly birds some eye features. Also I bought some other blue-toned colors to bring out the depth of the feathers a bit. I also added acrylic gold to the resin  “gold” which was partially painted over with the white from the bottom part of the birds, making the candle holders look like a cheap knockoff, trying to  imitate real craftsmanship in metal and ceramic and be it resin (resin having been indicated in the ad). These rather pricey bird candleholders are an embarrassment and I cannot place them among my antiques. I felt completely mislead by your ad. Ever since, your emails have been directed to automatically land in Trash.
Heading: When I ordered a pair of bird-candle…

Body: Great product, arrived on tîme and beautifully packaged
Heading: Mrs Alice parrot candlesicks

Author: Catherine
Body: When writing this review, I realized I really have purchased several (okay, MANY :)  items from Mrs. Alice and have been so pleased with each piece.  Refreshing our holiday table has been lots of fun with their offerings and they fold in seamlessly with my other items, gathered over the years.  The candle holders are wonderful, and the quality really is fabulous. But I do need to give an extra shout out to the parrots!  My husband is still not convinced but if I slip them in sparingly, they make any occasion a fabulous event.  They really are fun and beautiful!  Thank you!
Heading: Much more than I thought!

Body: Very good and fast service, thank you!

Author: Catherine Robson

Author: katie Warren
Body:
The table cloth is just divine, and the service impeccable.
Thank you.

Author: Marie Arden
Body: Always a prompt delivery and very fair delivery fee. Everything is quality and wrapped beautifully. I give many of the items I purchase as gifts. The candle holders and bird candle holders are so pretty and made so well. I have ordered many times and will continue to do so.
Heading: Lovely products and prompt delivery…

Author: Constance
Body: I love every piece I have ever ordered and packaging was always safe so items were always in perfect condition!
Heading: A fan of Alice products and service

Author: Misho Dimitrov
Body: I have been using Mrs Alice for 2 years and eery time I have great experience. The order arrives fast, the packaging is amazing. every item is wrapped carefully and arrives in good form, the item are just lovely. greta peaces for my party tables. I'll highly recommend them.
Heading: Just Great!

Author: Tshah
Body: Absolutely stunning service. I just love scrolling through the site and looking at all the beautiful table settings. I ordered a set of soft blue placemats and napkins as a wedding gift for my friends in America. I had this monogrammed with their initials which I felt was a really special touch for newly weds. Delivery to them was super speedy and it was packed beautifully in matching tissue paper and ribbons. I also was able to add a gift note for them as well. All in all, super happy with the Mrs. Alice service !
Heading: Absolutely stunning service

Author: Consumer
Body: Brilliant customer service experience and fabulous products beautifully wrapped then they arrived.
Heading: Brilliant customer service experience…

Author: Karen
Body: Love, love, love the Blue Parrot Candleholders! I get so many compliments on them. Very pleased.
Heading: Pleasing

Author: Cristina
Body: I recently received my order of Blue Parrot candleholders from Mr. Alice, and I'm genuinely impressed by their exceptional service and beautifully packaged products. If you're in search of exquisite table decorations, I highly recommend them.

Author: AJ
Body: Been a customer since the first month, and every order never fails to delight. Beautiful product and impeccable service.

Author: Sunita M

Author: Louis Turner
Body: Wife loved the plates I got for our anniversary present. Very quick shipping and beautifully packaged. 👍🏻

Author: Amber
Body: Ordered some beautiful sets of bamboo cutlery from here. Arrived the same week and are lovely quality. Sadly, one of my children broke 2 of the spoons! However, Sarah was absolutely amazing and managed to get 2 spoons custom ordered for me and sent out so that I didn’t need to rebuy a whole set. Thank you so much!
Heading: Stunning Cutlery and Amazing Service!

Author: Hamish
Body: Brought a set of four plates from the summer sale, came the next day! Great fast delivery and lovely plates.
Heading: Fast delivery & great quality

Author: Erica de Sisgoreo
Body: I ordered and paid a tea table in April, it’s August and I still don’t have received anything. They work like this, you order, they don’t have nothing available, they order to their suppliers in Asia… you wait for months. Quite a scam.
Heading: Stay away from this shop

Author: Nicola C
Body: I just wanted to buy some plates, left them in my basket for a while, 2 hours not days, then received a discount code that didn't work and silly amounts of follow up emails. Seemed both desperate and grabby. Found similar  ( basically the same) plates from a turkish supplier later for far less on etsy.
Heading: I just wanted to buy some plates

Author: Mitzi Tofte
Body: I got what I ordered, in good time
Heading: I got what I ordered

Author: Symon
Body:
Wrong Item Sent
Ordered tablecloth. From measurement choice as per website. 
It arrived. 
In measurements that weren’t even on the website. 

Reached out. 
Offered a different TC in different pattern. Not what I wanted. 

Took screen shot of measurements page of website at 2pm. 

By now the email thread has gone quiet. 

Took screen shot of same page as above at 5pm. ALL measurements are now different. And include the mysterious size that was sent to me. 
Funny how that all changed during our convo. 

Still not heard back. 
Have demanded refund. 
Twice. 

All in all. A pretty P!ss Poor experience. 

Just seems to be the norm these days. 
Treating your customers like morons. 

Letting you into a little secret Alice. 
It don’t work!!!!

Now. 

Get this table cloth collected. Refund my money. And let’s move on.
Heading: Wrong Item Sent
